title: Zeno Power runs a two-week underwater generator test in Washington waters
summary: An electrically heated Stirling generator produced over 20 watts on the seabed. Later units are meant to run on strontium-90 decay heat instead.

title: Fervo signs a transmission agreement with Longroad Energy for 105 MW at Cape Station
summary: The deal secures a path to the grid for part of Fervo's flagship enhanced geothermal project in Utah.

title: Bedrock Energy raises $24M to build more autonomous geothermal drill rigs
summary: The Series B funds rigs that drill ground-source heating and cooling fields for large buildings.

title: NRC issues a construction permit for X-energy's Long Mott plant at Dow's Texas site
summary: Long Mott is planned as the first US commercial advanced reactor built to supply industrial process heat.

title: Google agrees to buy 50 MW from Quaise's superhot geothermal project in Oregon
summary: Power from the Newberry Volcano site could arrive as early as 2030. Quaise is still testing the millimeter-wave drilling the plant depends on.

title: Helion's Polaris machine reaches 150 million °C on deuterium-tritium fuel
summary: A step toward the plant Helion has promised will sell electricity to Microsoft starting in 2028.
